Overview.Name: Vinay
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), feeling energetic & confident, mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1_Breakfast: 100g fish or chicken (pan fried, minimal spices)
1 small bowl rice (with a spoon of ghee for satiety)
Meal_2_Lunch: 150g chicken or fish (grilled or pan fried)
1 small bowl rice with cooked vegetables (avoid potato, mutton)
Snack_Optional: Puffed rice or makhana with a spoon of ghee and pinch of salt

Notes_and_Tips: Focus on whole ingredients: eggs, chicken, fish, curd, rice, and vegetables. Avoid mutton, potato, and processed foods.
Keep cooking simple and quick — pan frying and grilling are ideal.
Since you have a busy schedule and family member cooks, keep meal prep minimal and repetitive.
Practice mindful eating: eat slowly, stop at comfortable fullness, and avoid late-night snacking.
For cravings, have savory snacks like puffed rice or makhana. Avoid fried and processed options.
Yoga and walking after meals will help manage stress and improve energy.
Social gatherings and late nights are common triggers — plan ahead with simple, portable meals.
This plan supports physique improvement, energy, and stress reduction. Consistency is key.
